stories.title: Quantum protocol securely verifies a device's position using stations 2 km apart
stories.desc: Reliably verifying the location of a device connected to the internet or other networks is important for various real-world applications. For instance, it could be valuable for authorizing financial transactions, securing communications and controlling who can access specific databases or services.
